_comment: Known-red entries: defects that are real, triaged, and not yet fixed.
Committed to the repo on purpose. `thalamus ceremony ack` keeps its store machine-local,
which would leave it empty in CI and make every known-red read there as a new regression.
`witness_contains` is the positive pin, and it is what stops this file being a mute button:
an entry that only says 'this fails' absorbs any future failure at the same site, while one
that names part of the witness breaks the moment the defect changes shape.
Delete an entry in the same change that fixes its defect. A stale entry makes the suite
exit 2, which is deliberate - a silently-fixed defect hides the next regression at that site.

expectations.note: docs/05's unliftability claim is false; all four separators in _TOKEN_RE's class lift. Handed to main in NOTE-for-main-unliftability-defect.md. If a fix closes hyphen but not _ . /, this entry DRIFTS and the run goes red - which is the intent.

verify_armed() detects correctly but is advisory, and install.py:1023 excludes advisory from the failure set. Not a claim that init is wrong - a claim that CI has no non-advisory path to consume the signal.
Shared jq prologue under set -e. Three distinct exit signatures (5 malformed / 0 empty / 127 no-jq); the pin is on 5 so that closing only one of the three drifts this entry rather than silencing it.

Allowlist is consulted in check_batch() after fetch/archive/extract. Pinned on the model-exposure half rather than the archive half, since that is the one with a security consequence. Port is random, so it is not part of the pin.

apply_ingress_floor rewrites decisions/problems/solutions but not threads/artifacts, though both carry provenance. ThreadRef is correctly absent - it has no tier to floor. Pinned on the exact uncovered set so covering one of the two drifts this entry.

fetch() returns the requested URL, discarding response.url, while urlopen follows redirects. Survives the obvious fix to ingest-allowlist-gates-fetch: moving the check ahead of fetch() still checks the pre-redirect URL.

No -L/-S anywhere in src/. tmux ignores HOME, so no environment redirection isolates it, and the arm-runner image has no tmux at all. Pinned on the count so scoping any subset drifts this entry rather than silently shrinking it.

The claim is narrow and it is the claim being pinned: a dial stamped into ranker_fingerprint as the configuration in force is captured where rebinding cannot reach it. Not a claim that the shipped value 8 is wrong. This shape has already produced a published wrong number once (lab/030 measured the cap as having zero effect because patching the constant did nothing while the run labelled itself with the patched value). Pinned on the capture site rather than the line number, which unrelated edits would move; a second dial acquiring a capture changes the witness and drifts this entry.
